entities.summary: Paul Edmund Kanjorski is an American former judge, lawyer, and politician who served as the U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 11th congressional district from 1985 until 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Paul Kanjorski was a legal figures from Nanticoke (b. 1937-04-02, Nanticoke). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
